# China: New preference margin in public procurement for goods produced in China

28 Sep 2025

In September 2025, the Chinese government introduced a new 20% preference margin for Chinese goods in public procurement tenders. The measure enters into force on 1 January 2026. The measure was initially proposed in December 2024.
